body.name: Morse incompressible-rigidity handle
body.construction: First use the synthetic product law and a Dacorogna--Moser correction to separate determinant distortion from a normalized volume-preserving map; then apply a Hodge decomposition, prove weighted \(C^k\) interpolation for its zero-fiber-mean divergence-free component, and absorb the determinant and ratio nonlinear remainders without losing the top derivative.
